headline: Fresenius Raises 2026 Earnings Outlook Following Q3 Profit Beat
summary: Fresenius raised its 2026 earnings outlook after reporting a third-quarter profit that surpassed market estimates.
why: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA is a major German global healthcare group providing products and services for dialysis, hospitals, and inpatient/outpatient care.

impacts.name: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA
impacts.why: Higher earnings outlook and a Q3 profit beat typically drive the company's share price higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The stock rallied as investors reacted positively to the upgraded full-year financial guidance and better-than-expected quarterly results.
